SPLINTER, an 11-sixteenth cell (3+3 LATTICE-cluster stabs + 5 tremolo) realigning every 11 bars; MINOR-THIRD AXIS F-Ab-B-D (octatonic, the counterpart of Moult's major-third wheel); every stab is t1 LATTICE stacked (root b9 #11 maj7); abrupt stops as form (Stop-start, Collapse sheds the cell slot by slot to a choked dead stop into t5). Opens on Moult's roll: one ringing bar under Moult's carried-over pad, then NINEFOLD at 204; Fracture sets 11 (guitars) v 9 (bass+kick, NINEFOLD) v 4/4. 160 bars, 190 s: ignition 12, splinter 33, swarm 22, stop-start 20, maw 16, splinter II 22, fracture 22, collapse 13. Mix: the kit owned >90% above 3 kHz, so kit -8 dB with -6 dB above 6 kHz on its bus, guitars +3 dB below 180 Hz; master eq/glue/clip, volume +2 (rms -9.7, crest 9.4). Terms: structure 100, variety 83, recurrence 100, rhythm 100 (off-grid .17), spectrum 93, master 100, cohesion 59, flow 57, distinct 100.
